hotels.description: Escape to one of Australia’s most exclusive private island retreats, where barefoot luxury meets complete seclusion and every moment feels entirely your own. Once an untamed sheep farm established in the 1800s, Louth Island now offerse a wealth of one-of-a-kind experiences, with near-exclusive access to Carl Cove - one of South Australia's best beaches - during Stage 1 of the resort's opening. Dine at Samphire, recently awarded two Chef’s Hats in the Australian Good Food Guide 2025, where native ingredients are the hero. Enjoy coastal daisy cocktails at sunset, fresh kingfish with wild herbs, and signature creations like the saltbush negroni. Spend your days kayak fishing, exploring hidden coves on buggy tours, and finishing with a barefoot beach picnic under the stars. Far more than a luxury escape, Rumi forms part of a visionary $60 million multistage development, with more than $10 million committed to restoring and preserving the island’s natural environment and unique heritage. With only a select number of guests, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy true privacy before the rest of the world arrives.

hotels.description: Indulge in eco-conscious elegance with a stay on South Australia’s most spectacular private island. On Louth Island, a wealth of one-of-a-kind experiences await, including dining at acclaimed, native-focused Samphire and near-exclusive access to Carl Cove, one of South Australia’s best beaches. Between kayaking adventures, beach picnics and guided buggy tours, get a taste for the land with flavourful local produce at Samphire. Here, the star is always the vibrant native ingredients - many grown right on the island - from cocktails with coastal daisy syrup and kingfish with spicy beach mustard, to sensational saltbush negronis and beyond.
